edits.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / illustration-story. Image 1 is the edit target, a comic atlas. Images 2,3,4 are authoritative ORIGINAL CHARACTER ART references: use only the left-side illustrations, never their printed text. Repaint the target in the painterly textured fantasy illustration style of these character references, with restrained outlines and natural rough materials. Preserve ALL scene compositions, poses, camera angles, relative character locations, objects, actions and exact 2 equal columns by 3 equal rows grid of six wide panels, square overall image. No text or balloons. Strong readable silhouettes, claustrophobic low ceilings where present. Replace the three protagonists consistently in every cell: NYRA is the Orchid reference, lavender skin, pointed ears, short pale blue-white crystalline crown instead of ANY long hair, white crystal growths over chest/shoulders, dark black-red layered ragged leather/cloth. Elegant severe expression. NICOLA is the slender small Quatryl reference, ochre skin, narrow long face, fine long limbs, two dark spare goggles on forehead AND glowing blue lenses over eyes, copper engineering armor, blue chest core and toolkit backpack. No round goblin ears, no chubby aviator, no red scarf. KREK is the Savvas reference, huge pale sandstone layered ridged stone body, amber eyes, black mouth and recessed dark chest cavity, modest ochre shoulder fittings and belt. Remove heavy bronze cuirass and blue eyes. Preserve Hail separately as the existing pale-haired translucent researcher; do not confuse Hail with Nyra. Preserve the old atlas's events without adding new characters or changing monster outcomes.

Use case: style-transfer. Image1 is edit target: cramped chamber scene. Image2 is original Orchid Spellweaver visual reference, image3 Quatryl Tinkerer, image4 Savvas Cragheart. Repaint with textured painterly fantasy materials from those originals, restrained ink, preserving composition and EXACTLY FIVE enemies: TWO very large ice demons at rear left/right, TWO smaller ice demons visibly distinct in front of them, ONE floating Living Spirit behind at center. Keep all five easy to count, low ceiling and narrow room. Preserve trio foreground positions/poses. Replace Nyra with lavender-skinned Orchid, short white-blue crystal crown, NO LONG HAIR, crystalline chest and shoulders, black/red layered cloth. Replace Nicola with slender fine-limbed small ochre Quatryl, narrow face, blue eye lenses plus dark goggles on forehead, copper mechanical armor/backpack and blue chest core, no scarf or goblin ears. Replace Krek with massive pale sandy layered stone Savvas, amber eyes, dark chest cavity, minimal ochre fittings, NO heavy metal armor or blue eyes. Original character reference illustrations take priority over old protagonist designs. No lettering, balloons or frames. Landscape.

Use case: illustration-story. Create a tightly cropped front-facing head overlay of NICOLA based on the left-side original Quatryl Tinkerer illustration in the reference. Narrow long ochre face, elongated delicate anatomy, copper-orange fitted headgear, TWO dark circular spare goggles on forehead ABOVE two luminous blue eye lenses. He looks directly at the viewer with intelligent dry curiosity. Keep the same painterly rough fantasy texture as reference. Include head and only a tiny copper collar, no torso. No goblin ears, no red scarf, not a rounded cute aviator. Entire outside silhouette genuinely transparent, no shadow background, no text. Square composition.
